annotations.title: Estate agent activity in an area

description:
Which estate agents actually transact in an area, ranked by listing count.

    Sale and rental are counted and averaged SEPARATELY — an asking price and a
    monthly rent do not combine into one median, so read `median_asking_price`
    and `median_monthly_rent` as answering different questions.

    `area_id` is the marts area id from `area_resolve`.

    UK only. Free.
name: agent_activity
title: Estate agent activity in an area
